answer: Bindings are kept in ember, verified in thread, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 2 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the atlas check. A farm generating text without memory of its own history as a result fails the binding, thus it has to store and read state per alias. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 7 epochs. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
